title: Orsen and the Tryouts
author: Zephyrine Montrose
blurb: Zephyrine Vane, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
